项目简介
本项目于2025年成功部署了一套定制化低空管控系统。通过集成可移动式频谱侦测车，系统具备了全域覆盖的侦测能力，配合导航诱骗设备实施精准反制。在指挥控制平台的统一管理下，实现了对无人机目标的实时预警与高效处置，显著提升了厂区应对非传统安全威胁的能力，有效保障了大型工业园区的生产安全与隐私防护。

Project Introduction:
In 2025, this project successfully deployed a customized low-altitude control system. By integrating a mobile spectrum detection vehicle, the system possesses full-area coverage detection capabilities and implements precise countermeasures in coordination with navigation spoofing equipment. Under the unified management of the command and control platform, it achieved real-time early warning and efficient disposal of drone targets. This significantly enhanced the factory area's ability to cope with non-traditional security threats, effectively ensuring the production safety and privacy protection of the large-scale industrial park.
